gloss: to shoulder, to carry on one's shoulder; to trick

definitions.gloss: to shoulder, to carry on one's shoulder
definitions.explanation: To support and carry something heavy on one's shoulder.

definitions.gloss: to set up (as a leader), to promote
definitions.explanation: To support someone as a candidate or leader.
To fool someone as a prank or joke.

examples.japanese: {荷物|にもつ}を{肩|かた}に{担|かつ}いで{運|はこ}ぶ。
examples.english: Carry the luggage on one's shoulder.
Carry a portable shrine (on one's shoulders).

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}を{担|かつ}いでびっくりさせた。
examples.english: I tricked my friend and surprised him.

notes:
{担|かつ}ぐ means to carry something on one's shoulder. It also has a colloquial meaning of 'to trick.'

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})
- Pattern: Xを{担|かつ}ぐ

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {神輿|みこし}を{担|かつ}ぐ (to carry a portable shrine)
- {荷物|にもつ}を{担|かつ}ぐ (to shoulder luggage)
- {人|ひと}を{担|かつ}ぐ (to trick/deceive someone)
- {候補者|こうほしゃ}を{担|かつ}ぐ (to back a candidate)

CULTURAL NOTE:
{神輿|みこし}を{担|かつ}ぐ is an important activity in Japanese festivals, where teams carry heavy portable shrines through the streets.

SIMILAR VERBS:
- {背負|せお}う (to carry on one's back)
- {抱|かか}える (to hold in one's arms)
